description: Represents an embedded non-text figure as ONE image_or_seal block: a national emblem, government seal or logo, official portrait, commemorative banner image, a scanned stamp or signature image, or an illustrative diagram.
applicability: The source contains an embedded image or figure (in OCR HTML an tag; in OCR markdown an ![...]() image).
Typical cases: a masthead emblem/seal/logo, an official portrait or commemorative banner, a scanned stamp/seal, or a diagram illustrating a rule.
instructions: Emit each embedded figure as ONE block of block_type image_or_seal, with a short description of what it depicts.
If the figure is document furniture (masthead emblem, seal, portrait, banner), keep it non-operative and in reading order.
If the figure sits inside a point (e.g. a diagram illustrating a rule), attach it to that point via parent_block_id.
Never transcribe a figure as body text or as a numbered point, and never silently drop it.

provenance.reason: Manually authored after auditing the source documents: embedded figures/emblems/seals are a distinct structural entity (block_type image_or_seal) that no existing skill owned.
